name: Mekényes (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Mekényes (a shield of blue and white with a red monogram on a green mound, a cross, a rose and a star) above a yellow scroll inscribed MEKÉNYES.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
